newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK CUTS DEPOSIT, LENDING RATES.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK CUTS DEPOSIT, LENDING RATES.

text.p: Greek private Xiosbank cut its savings rate by 50 basis points to 9.0 percent, its business credit loan rate by 150 bassis points to 17 percent and its Xios auto lending rate by 100 basis points to 17.5 percent, it said.
Xiosbank which goes public on Tuesday cited falling inflation as the reason for slashing its deposit and lending rates, it said in a statement.

Its XiosAlma deposit account which pays interest monthly will offer an annual yield of 9.93 percent for balances above 2.0 million drachmas, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
